errors.not_registered: this machine is not a runner yet ({path} does not exist): run `thulu runner register`
errors.bad_ref: the daemon sent a branch git does not accept: {ref}
errors.project_unmapped: project {project} ({id}) has no folder on this runner: run `thulu runner add-project {id} <dir>`
errors.missing_tools: this machine is missing what a run needs: {tools}
errors.no_engine: this machine has no engine CLI on its PATH: install one of {binaries}
errors.engine_unsupported: this runner cannot run {engine}: its script needs a container
errors.engine_missing: this machine does not have {engine}: install it so `{binary}` is on the runner's PATH, then sign in
errors.wrong_repo: the folder {path} mapped to project {project} is another repository: its origin is {origin}, the project is {want}. Fix the mapping with `thulu runner add-project`.
errors.project_file: copy {file} from the checkout: only relative paths inside it
errors.left_branch: the agent left project {project} on {head} instead of {branch}: nothing was committed or pushed for it
errors.folder_not_allowed: project {project}: {path} is outside the folders this machine allows. Allow it here with `thulu runner allow <dir>`
errors.folder_not_a_repo: project {project}: {path} is not a git repository on this machine
errors.add_not_registered: this machine is not a runner yet: in Thulu go to Settings → Runners → Add this machine and run the commands it shows
errors.add_not_a_repo: {path} is not inside a git repository: run `git init` there first, or run `thulu add` from a repository
errors.add_not_listed: {path} was allowed, but the scan of this machine's folders did not list it; check `thulu runner folders`
errors.add_unsupported: the Thulu this runner reports to does not support `thulu add` yet: update it, or add the project from New project in the dashboard
errors.add_revoked: Thulu refused this runner's credential (it was revoked?): register this machine again from Settings → Runners
errors.add_refused: Thulu did not add the project: {err}
errors.result_push: push the run's work on project {project} to {ref} in Thulu
errors.no_task_branch: the daemon sent no task branch for project {project}, and this run writes to it
errors.daemon_list: list the branches of project {project} in Thulu
errors.daemon_missing_branch: Thulu has no branch {branch} for project {project}
errors.result_unsent: the run's work on project {project} did not reach Thulu; this machine keeps it as {ref} in its copy of the project and sends it with the task's next run
errors.result_kept: the run's work on project {project} did not reach Thulu and could not be saved; this machine keeps the folder {path} and saves it the next time the runner starts
errors.turn_outputs: send the turn's answer to Thulu
errors.leftover_mirror: find the copy of the project that {path} came from
errors.mcp_not_found: there is no MCP called {name} in ~/.claude.json or the project's .mcp.json; `claude mcp list` shows the names this machine has
errors.no_local_mcps: found no MCP to import in ~/.claude.json or the project's .mcp.json (-project <dir> reads a project's)
errors.mcp_bad_name: {name} is not an MCP name: use letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore, or "claude.ai <Name>" for a connector
errors.mcp_needs_definition: {name} is not in the runner's MCP file: pass -url, or the command after --, or import it with `thulu runner mcp import {name}`
errors.mcp_needs_definition_flags: an MCP needs -url or a command after --
errors.mcp_not_listed: {name} is not in the runner's MCP selection
errors.bad_local_tools: local_tools is {value}: use thulu, selected or all
errors.mcp_list: list this machine's MCPs with `claude mcp list`
errors.no_run_start: the run's starting commit is unknown and the default branch does not resolve, so what the run changed cannot be read
errors.unsupported_os: this runner cannot take runs on {os}: it stops every process a run starts by reading the process table, which it can do only on macOS and Linux
errors.procargs: read a process's arguments and environment
errors.memory_limit: run went over its memory limit ({limit}): {command} used {used}, the whole run {total}
errors.memory_limit_kernel: run went over its memory limit ({limit}): the kernel stopped one of its processes for it, so the runner stopped the whole run
errors.machine_low_memory: the machine had {available} available, under its floor of {floor}, so the runner stopped this run, the largest on it ({used})
errors.scope_no_systemd: systemd-run is not on the PATH
errors.scope_no_memory: the systemd user manager does not have the memory controller ({path})
errors.scope_not_linux: systemd scopes exist only on Linux
errors.top: read the processes' memory footprint with top
errors.worktree_not_saved: the clone did not keep the worktree's HEAD under {ref}
errors.fork_watch: open a kqueue to watch a run's processes

log.output_skipped: run {job}: {path} ({size} bytes) did not fit the outputs upload and stayed on this machine
log.no_projects: no folders allowed yet: run `thulu add` inside a repository, or allow a folder with `thulu runner allow <dir>`
log.started: runner {name} taking runs from {daemon} ({projects} projects, {concurrency} at a time)
log.claim_failed: ask the daemon for a run: {err}
log.swept: left over from a previous runner process: run {job} stopped and its folder removed
log.fetch_failed: fetch {branch} in {repo}; the task branch starts from what the checkout already has
log.upstream_failed: make {branch} track origin in {repo}; a plain git push from the agent will ask for an upstream
log.ship_failed: send {bytes} bytes of run {job}'s log; the daemon's copy has a gap there
log.pid_file_failed: write the run's pid file in {path}; if this runner dies, the next start cannot stop the run
log.chat_swept: chat {chat} had no turn for 30 days: its folder and session removed
log.group_check_failed: check whether process group {pid} is still running
log.checkout_state_failed: read the state of the checkout {path}
log.folders_unsupported: the daemon does not take folder reports (it predates them); projects keep running from this runner's config
log.folders_report_failed: report this machine's folders to the daemon: {err}
log.reload_failed: read the runner config again; keeping the folders it had
log.mirror_prune_failed: drop a finished task's branch from the copy of project {project}
log.steer_failed: ask the daemon for messages to run {job}: {err}
log.steer_unlock_failed: release the message queue lock {path}; the agent waits 5 s for it
log.unsent_failed: send project {project}'s work from an earlier run to Thulu; the next run tries again
log.unsent_sent: sent {ref}, the work of an earlier run on project {project}, to Thulu
log.run_kept: {path} keeps work that did not reach Thulu; the next start of the runner saves it
log.leftover_save_failed: save the work a previous runner process left in {path}
log.test_files_failed: read the locked tests of project {project} for run {job}; the daemon will say it could not check them
log.proc_list_failed: run {job}: list this machine's processes; the run's process set is as of the last read
log.track_save_failed: run {job}: save the record of its processes; if this runner dies now, the next start may not find them all
log.details_failed: read the memory and command line of the processes a run leaves
log.kill_survivor: run {job}: pid {pid} ({rss} MB) is still running after SIGKILL: {command}
log.kill_done: run {job}: stopped {count} processes it left running, {left} still running
log.kill_note_failed: write to run {job}'s log what the runner stopped
log.run_kept_alive: run {job}: {count} of its processes are still running, so {path} and its record stay for the next sweep
log.root_recreated: run {job}: {path} came back after it was removed; something of the run still writes there, stopping it again
log.deadline: run {job} went over its time limit ({limit}), so the runner stopped it
log.daemon_lost: Thulu did not answer run {job} for longer than its lease ({lease}), so the runner stopped it
log.daemon_lost_stop: run {job}: {failures} heartbeats in a row failed and Thulu has not answered for {gone}, longer than the lease plus the time a restart may take: stopping the run ({err})
log.machine_woke: the machine woke up ({gap} since the last check): looking for what ended runs left running
log.sweep_list_failed: list this machine's processes to find what ended runs left running; the next sweep tries again
log.record_unreadable: read the run record {path}; it is removed, and the run's markers still find its processes
log.chat_turn_swept: left over from a turn of chat {chat} the runner did not finish: its processes stopped and the turn's files removed
log.machine_low_memory: the machine has {available} MB available, under the {floor} MB floor: stopping run {job}, the largest ({used})
log.admission_paused: not taking runs: {available} available, below the {min} minimum
log.admission_resumed: taking runs again: {available} available, above the {min} minimum
log.memory_probe_failed: could not read the machine's available memory, so the runner takes runs without checking it
log.memory_check_off: warning: {setting} is negative in runner.json, so the runner does not check it
log.memory_cap_cgroup: each run is capped at {limit}, held by the kernel in a systemd scope
log.memory_cap_watcher: each run is capped at {limit}, held by a watcher that adds up its processes every 2 s ({reason})
log.memory_sample_failed: read the memory of a run's processes
log.scope_kill_failed: could not kill what is left in the systemd scope {unit}
log.scope_reset_failed: could not drop the failed systemd scope {unit}
log.outside_removed_cwd: run {job}: removed {path} ({size}), left outside the run: pid {pid} ({command}) of the run was working in it
log.outside_removed_copy: run {job}: removed {path} ({size}), a copy of the run's worktree left outside the run (its .git points at {gitdir})
log.outside_left: run {job}: left {path} ({size}) where it is: nothing ties it to the run for sure
log.container_left: run {job}: container {name} ({state}) was created while the run ran, and nothing ties it to the run, so the runner leaves it alone
log.build_cache_pruned: run {job}: removed the build cache {path} ({size}), over build_cache_max_mb ({max} MB)
log.worktrees_unsupported: the daemon does not list open task branches; the runner keeps every task worktree
log.worktrees_list_failed: could not ask the daemon which task branches are open, so no worktree is removed this time: {err}
log.worktree_saved: saved the work left in {path} as {ref} in the runner's clone before removing it
log.worktree_kept: kept the worktree {path} of branch {branch}, which no open task uses: its work could not be saved ({err})
log.worktree_removed: removed the worktree {path} of branch {branch}, which no open task uses ({size})
log.worktree_stray_removed: removed {path} from the worktrees folder: it is not the worktree of any task ({size})
log.mirror_removed: removed the clone {path}: its project is not this runner's any more and nothing in it waits to be sent ({size})
log.fork_watch_failed: run {job}: watch its processes for forks; the runner reads the process table every {every} instead, and a process that leaves the run between two reads may be missed
log.swept_before_boot: run {job} started at {started}, before this machine booted: nothing of it can still run, so the runner signals none of the pids it named
log.container_removed: run {job}: removed container {name} ({state}), created during the run from {path}, which is the run's
log.container_remove_failed: remove container {id}, which the run created; it is reported on the run instead
log.fork_watch_close_failed: close the kqueue that watched a run's processes

warnings.checkout_changed: The checkout at {path} changed while the agent ran (its HEAD or its files). If nobody worked in it, check what the agent did there.
warnings.mcp_missing: The runner selects the MCP {name}, but {file} does not define it, so this run went without it. Add it with `thulu runner mcp add {name} …` or drop it with `thulu runner mcp remove {name}`.
warnings.connectors_off: The runner selects claude.ai connectors, but it could not list this machine's MCPs ({err}), so this run loaded no connector and no MCP outside the selection. `thulu runner doctor` on the machine shows why.
warnings.bypass_off_no_tools: A Claude Code policy on this machine ({source}) turns off --dangerously-skip-permissions. The run went in dontAsk mode with only Thulu's MCP tools allowed, so Bash, Edit and Write were denied. List what runs may use with `thulu runner config allowed-tools 'Bash(git *)' Edit Write …` on the machine.
warnings.bypass_off: A Claude Code policy ({source}) turns off --dangerously-skip-permissions: running in dontAsk mode with allowed_tools {tools} plus the run's MCP tools.
warnings.run_survivors: The runner could not stop {count} processes this run started: {pids}. They keep running on the machine, and the next sweep of the runner tries again.
warnings.left_in_tmp: left in {dir}: {path} ({size}). Nothing ties it to this run for sure, so the runner kept it; remove it if nothing uses it.
warnings.left_in_tmp_more: and {count} more new entries in {dir}; the runner's log lists them.
warnings.container_running: container {name} started during this run is still running. Nothing ties it to the run (no compose project or bind mount in the run's folders), so the runner left it: `docker rm -f {name}` if the run left it.
warnings.container_left: container {name} created during this run is still there ({state}); nothing ties it to the run, so the runner left it.
